title: Fan-Shaped Back Stroking
summary: The palms fan outward from the central back toward the sides in broad, gentle strokes.
goal: Warm a broad area of the back and distribute contact smoothly toward the sides.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of fan-shaped back stroking without text labels.
startingPosition: The person lies face down. Place the palms near each other on the lower or middle back.
instructions: Begin with both palms near the center line without pressing on the spine.
Continue the arc toward the sides of the back.
Reduce pressure near the outer edge of the torso.
Return to the start and repeat the fan pattern on the next area.
direction: Movements fan outward from the center with a slight upward direction.
tips: Keep the arcs broad and even on both sides.
Reduce pressure near the edge of the torso.
mistakes: Using strokes that are too short or narrow.
Abrupt wrist turns at the side of the torso.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
